name: Apartments Stubai
beschreibung:
Overview

The Apartment Stubai is a privately run holiday apartment in the Milders district of Neustift im Stubaital in Tyrol. The modern apartment, measuring around 55 m², accommodates up to four people and features a kitchen-living room, two separate bedrooms and a bathroom with a rain shower and a separate WC. The amenities include a fully equipped kitchen with oven, microwave, dishwasher, fridge-freezer, coffee machine, toaster and kettle, a cosy seating area with Smart TV and box-spring beds in both bedrooms. A garden with terrace and garden furniture as well as a ski storage room with a ski boot dryer are available for exclusive use. A covered car parking space in the carport, Wi-Fi, bed linen and towels are free of charge, and an EV charging station (wallbox, type 2) is available for a fee. The house is a non-smoking house; pets are not allowed in the apartment.

History/Background

Apartment Stubai is privately operated; according to the legal notice, Helga Salchner is responsible for the content. On their own website, Helga and Steffen welcome their guests to a newly and modernly furnished apartment. The accommodation is located in the Stubai Valley, which according to the regional portal stubaital-appartements.at lies about 20 kilometres south of Innsbruck; the Stubai Glacier is one of the largest glacier ski areas in Austria.

Getting there

The address is Franz-Senn-Straße 58, 6167 Neustift im Stubaital in the Milders district. The ski bus stop is about 70 metres away on foot, a supermarket (Spar) with an ATM is a few minutes' walk (approx. 400 m) away, and a ski rental shop is about 350 metres away. The village centre of Neustift is about two kilometres away via a dedicated footpath along the stream. Arrival is from the direction of Innsbruck; according to the regional portal, Innsbruck Airport is about 25 kilometres away.

Tips

In the summer season (roughly late May to mid-October), guests receive the Stubai Super Card at no extra charge, with numerous benefits in the valley. For an additional charge, a daily bread roll service is possible, an e-car charging station is available for a fee and a charcoal barbecue can be used (charcoal not included). Payment is exclusively in cash. For stays of eight days or more there is a 5% discount, and from 14 days 7.5% (in each case excluding the main winter season). Final cleaning costs €80 per stay, plus a tourist tax of €4.80 per person per night from the age of 15.

Best time to travel

In winter, Milders and the Stubai Valley are ideal for skiing and snowboarding days; the Stubai Glacier, one of the largest glacier ski areas in Austria, allows winter sports all year round according to the regional portal. In summer, hiking, mountain biking and climbing are on offer. Anyone wishing to use the Stubai Super Card should travel in the summer season between late May and mid-October.
